However, subject-level authenticity is compromised by multiple AI artifacts: (1) structural collapse in leftmost koala's paw merging with log surface, (2) texture anomalies in stripe patterns appearing flat-mapped rather than integrated with fur geometry, (3) missing fine anatomical details (digits, claws, opposable thumbs) across all koalas, (4) animal pose auditor's 94% low-confidence keypoint ratio indicating widespread structural uncertainty. The fine-grained classifier's failure to rank 'koala' in top-3 predictions further suggests the model struggled with species-specific feature generation. These defects are localized to the subjects and do not catastrophically undermine overall scene coherence, but they prevent a high authenticity score.
